title: Data Plane — Metadata Model + Loader + Validator
description: Implement data loading with time-aware metadata validation. Load CSV/Parquet, validate against data contract, record available_at/as_of_date/revision_timestamp.
action: Create synapse/data/ module: (1) DatasetMetadata pydantic-like model (use dataclass) with fields: dataset_id, name, source, asset_class, frequency, start_date, end_date, timezone, available_at_policy, adjustment_policy, survivorship_policy, missing_value_policy, created_at; (2) load_dataset(data_path, metadata_path) that reads CSV/Parquet + YAML metadata; (3) validate_dataset(metadata) that checks required fields, returns list of errors; (4) Sample data: create data/sample/sample_prices.csv with 100 rows of fake stock data (date, ticker, close, volume) and matching YAML metadata.
implementation: Create synapse/data/metadata.py: @dataclass DatasetMetadata with all contract fields, from_yaml(path) classmethod, to_yaml(path) method
Create synapse/data/loader.py: load_csv(path) -> DataFrame, load_parquet(path) -> DataFrame, load_dataset(data_path, metadata_path) -> tuple[DataFrame, DatasetMetadata]
Create synapse/data/validator.py: validate_metadata(metadata: DatasetMetadata) -> list[str] checking required fields, time range consistency
Create data/sample/sample_prices.csv: 100 rows, columns: date (2024-01-01 to 2024-05-10), ticker (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL), close (random 100-200), volume (random 1M-10M)

Create data/sample/sample_prices.yaml: dataset_id='sample-prices', name='Sample Daily Prices', source='synthetic', asset_class='equity', frequency='daily', start_date='2024-01-01', end_date='2024-05-10', available_at_policy='end-of-day'

criteria: python -c 'from synapse.data.metadata import DatasetMetadata; m = DatasetMetadata(dataset_id="test", name="test", source="test", asset_class="equity", frequency="daily", start_date="2024-01-01", end_date="2024-12-31", timezone="UTC", available_at_policy="eod", adjustment_policy="none", survivorship_policy="none", missing_value_policy="drop", created_at="2024-01-01"); print(m.dataset_id)' outputs 'test'
python -c 'from synapse.data.loader import load_dataset; df, meta = load_dataset("data/sample/sample_prices.csv", "data/sample/sample_prices.yaml"); print(len(df))' outputs '100'
